name: @wynding/server
description: AWS Lambda handlers: score validation (re-simulates a submitted replay) and the end-of-run survey endpoint.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && esbuild src/handler.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --outfile=dist/handler.mjs --sourcemap && esbuild src/survey.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --outfile=dist/survey.mjs --sourcemap "--banner:js=import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" && mkdir -p dist/rulesets && cp ../../packages/content/src/rulesets/*.json dist/rulesets/
